title: VaLoP: Value Gradient Lookahead and Pullback for Reward-Guided Diffusion
abstract: arXiv:2610.35607v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Reward guidance steers a pretrained diffusion or flow model toward images or actions that a reward model prefers, at sampling time and without retraining the model for each reward. It follows the gradient of a value function, the expected reward given the noisy state. The two common estimates of this gradient, gradients through a one-step denoised estimate and learned value models, are least accurate at high noise, where the coarse structure of the sample is decided. Interestingly, we find that both errors are posterior covariances, which grow with the uncertainty about the clean sample, and hence at higher noise. To reduce them, we evaluate the value at a less noisy state, one sampler step ahead, where this uncertainty is smaller, and pull its gradient back to the current state. translated_title: VaLoP：面向奖励引导扩散模型的价值梯度前瞻与回拉方法
translated_abstract: 奖励引导能够在采样阶段将预训练的扩散模型或流模型引导至奖励模型所偏好的图像或动作，而无需针对每个奖励重新训练模型。其核心是遵循价值函数的梯度，即在给定噪声状态下期望奖励的梯度。对这一梯度的两种常见估计方法——通过单步去噪估计计算的梯度和学习得到的价值模型——在高噪声阶段最不准确，而高噪声阶段恰恰决定了样本的粗略结构。有趣的是，我们发现这两种误差均为后验协方差，它们随着对干净样本不确定性的增大而增大，因此在更高噪声下更为严重。为了降低这些误差，我们在噪声更小的状态（即向前一步的采样状态）上评估价值函数，此时不确定性更小，然后将其梯度回拉至当前状态。这种前瞻方式将两种估计器置于同一族的两端，并揭示了中间前瞻需要一个额外的项，即一个修正项……
tldr: 提出VaLoP方法，通过在噪声更小的“向前一步”状态上评估价值函数梯度并将其回拉到当前状态，显著降低高噪声阶段奖励引导扩散模型的梯度估计误差，并统一了两种常见梯度估计器。
en_tdlr: VaLoP improves reward-guided diffusion by evaluating the value gradient at a less noisy one-step-ahead state and pulling it back to the current state, reducing high-noise gradient estimation errors and unifying the two common estimators as endpoints of a single family.
